Method of Attack: Speculative execution attack exploiting return instructions to bypass retpoline mitigation
Forcing return operations to be predicted like indirect branches
Injecting branch targets in kernel address-space regardless of user privileges
Hijacking return instructions to leak sensitive kernel memory
Impacted Systems: Intel Core CPUs generation 6 (Skylake - 2015) through 8 (Coffee Lake - 2017)
AMD Zen 1, Zen 1+, Zen 2 processors released between 2017 and 2019
Attack Vector: Branch target injection in kernel address-space via return instructions
